test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In March 2022, which state has became the first to start 'Air Health Service' in rural areas?
solution:
The correct answer is **'**Odisha.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ​**Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik** launched Mukhyamantri Vayu Swasthya Seva (**air health services**).
 
• With this scheme, it became one of the** first states to provide air ambulance facilities** for the poor in rural interior areas.
 
• The people of tribal-dominated districts such as **Malkangiri, Nabarangpur, Nuapada, **and** Kalahandi** will be able to get better healthcare services free of cost.
